Draft a read-mode agent manifest with slug `report-managed-devices-count-llm-scheduled` that loads managed devices from Graph (/deviceManagement/managedDevices, GET, scope DeviceManagementManagedDevices.Read.All) selecting id, deviceName, operatingSystem, complianceState, lastSyncDateTime, userPrincipalName, model, managedDeviceOwnerType, breaks them down with a count transform, and summarizes with an llm skill. ```yaml
descriptor:
  id: report-managed-devices-count-llm-scheduled
  name: Report managed devices count llm scheduled
  description: Reviews managed devices and reports findings for admin review.
  version: 0.1.0
  minAppVersion: 0.1.0
  author:
    name: Community
    handle: community
  category: devices
  mode: read
skills:
  - id: load_managed_devices
    format: graph
    label: Load managed devices
    detail: Reads managed devices from the active tenant.
    settings:
      method: GET
      path: /deviceManagement/managedDevices
      select:
        - id
        - deviceName
        - operatingSystem
        - complianceState
        - lastSyncDateTime
        - userPrincipalName
        - model
        - managedDeviceOwnerType
      scopes:
        - DeviceManagementManagedDevices.Read.All
  - id: count_by_operatingsystem
    format: transform
    label: Count managed devices by operatingSystem
    detail: Breaks managed devices down by operatingSystem.
    settings:
      kind: count-by-field
      source: '{{ load_managed_devices.output }}'
      field: operatingSystem
      buckets:
        - Windows
        - macOS
        - iOS
        - Android
  - id: summarize
    format: llm
    label: Summarize findings with the active LLM
    detail: Generates a short managed devices report.
    settings:
      system: >-
        You review managed devices for Microsoft 365 admins. Be concise, factual, and conservative.
        Use only the supplied data.
      prompt: >-
        Total managed devices: {{ load_managed_devices.output | size }}. Details: {{
        count_by_operatingsystem.output }}. Write a compact report: main finding, what to verify,
        next actions.
      temperature: 0.2
      maxTokens: 400
definition:
  triggers:
    - id: manual
      kind: manual
    - id: schedule
      kind: scheduled
      intervalSeconds: 604800
  result:
    summary: '{{ summarize.output.text | default("Summary unavailable.") }}'
    data:
      total: '{{ load_managed_devices.output | size }}'
      breakdown: '{{ count_by_operatingsystem.output }}'
      llmSummary: '{{ summarize.output.text }}'
```

```yaml
descriptor:
  id: audit-organization-details-sort-llm-scheduled
  name: Audit organization details sort llm scheduled
  description: Reviews organization details and reports findings for admin review.
  version: 0.1.0
  minAppVersion: 0.1.0
  author:
    name: Community
    handle: community
  category: compliance
  mode: read
skills:
  - id: load_organization_details
    format: graph
    label: Load organization details
    detail: Reads organization details from the active tenant.
    settings:
      method: GET
      path: /organization
      select:
        - id
        - displayName
        - verifiedDomains
        - createdDateTime
      scopes:
        - Organization.Read.All
  - id: oldest_items
    format: transform
    label: Sample organization details by createdDateTime
    detail: Lists organization details ordered by createdDateTime.
    settings:
      kind: sort-by
      source: '{{ load_organization_details.output }}'
      field: createdDateTime
      direction: asc
      take: 10
  - id: summarize
    format: llm
    label: Summarize findings with the active LLM
    detail: Generates a short organization details report.
    settings:
      system: >-
        You review organization details for Microsoft 365 admins. Be concise, factual, and
        conservative. Use only the supplied data.
      prompt: >-
        Total organization details: {{ load_organization_details.output | size }}. Details: {{
        load_organization_details.output }}. Write a compact report: main finding, what to verify,
        next actions.
      temperature: 0.2
      maxTokens: 400
definition:
  triggers:
    - id: manual
      kind: manual
    - id: schedule
      kind: scheduled
      intervalSeconds: 604800
  result:
    summary: '{{ summarize.output.text | default("Summary unavailable.") }}'
    data:
      total: '{{ load_organization_details.output | size }}'
      sample: '{{ oldest_items.output }}'
      llmSummary: '{{ summarize.output.text }}'
```

```yaml
descriptor:
  id: review-entra-device-objects-sort-llm-scheduled
  name: Review entra device objects sort llm scheduled
  description: Reviews Entra device objects and reports findings for admin review.
  version: 0.1.0
  minAppVersion: 0.1.0
  author:
    name: Community
    handle: community
  category: devices
  mode: read
skills:
  - id: load_entra_device_objects
    format: graph
    label: Load Entra device objects
    detail: Reads Entra device objects from the active tenant.
    settings:
      method: GET
      path: /devices
      select:
        - id
        - displayName
        - operatingSystem
        - accountEnabled
        - approximateLastSignInDateTime
      scopes:
        - Device.Read.All
  - id: oldest_items
    format: transform
    label: Sample Entra device objects by approximateLastSignInDateTime
    detail: Lists Entra device objects ordered by approximateLastSignInDateTime.
    settings:
      kind: sort-by
      source: '{{ load_entra_device_objects.output }}'
      field: approximateLastSignInDateTime
      direction: asc
      take: 10
  - id: summarize
    format: llm
    label: Summarize findings with the active LLM
    detail: Generates a short Entra device objects report.
    settings:
      system: >-
        You review Entra device objects for Microsoft 365 admins. Be concise, factual, and
        conservative. Use only the supplied data.
      prompt: >-
        Total Entra device objects: {{ load_entra_device_objects.output | size }}. Details: {{
        load_entra_device_objects.output }}. Write a compact report: main finding, what to verify,
        next actions.

      maxTokens: 400

  triggers:

      kind: manual
    - id: schedule

      intervalSeconds: 604800

    summary: '{{ summarize.output.text | default("Summary unavailable.") }}'

      sample: '{{ oldest_items.output }}'
      llmSummary: '{{ summarize.output.text }}'
```

descriptor:
  id: report-users-count-llm-scheduled
  name: Report users count llm scheduled
  description: Reviews users and reports findings for admin review.
  version: 0.1.0
  minAppVersion: 0.1.0
  author:
    name: Community
    handle: community
  category: policies
  mode: read
skills:
  - id: load_users
    format: graph
    label: Load users
    detail: Reads users from the active tenant.
    settings:
      method: GET
      path: /users
      select:
        - id
        - displayName
        - userPrincipalName
        - accountEnabled
        - userType
        - createdDateTime
      scopes:
        - User.Read.All
  - id: count_by_usertype
    format: transform
    label: Count users by userType
    detail: Breaks users down by userType.
    settings:
      kind: count-by-field
      source: '{{ load_users.output }}'
      field: userType
      buckets:
        - Member
        - Guest
  - id: summarize
    format: llm
    label: Summarize findings with the active LLM
    detail: Generates a short users report.
    settings:
      system: >-
        You review users for Microsoft 365 admins. Be concise, factual, and conservative. Use only
        the supplied data.
      prompt: >-
        Total users: {{ load_users.output | size }}. Details: {{ count_by_usertype.output }}. Write
        a compact report: main finding, what to verify, next actions.
      temperature: 0.2
      maxTokens: 400
definition:
  triggers:
    - id: manual
      kind: manual
    - id: schedule
      kind: scheduled
      intervalSeconds: 604800
  result:
    summary: '{{ summarize.output.text | default("Summary unavailable.") }}'
    data:
      total: '{{ load_users.output | size }}'
      breakdown: '{{ count_by_usertype.output }}'
      llmSummary: '{{ summarize.output.text }}'
```

descriptor:

      total: '{{ load_conditional_access_policies.output | size }}'

```yaml
descriptor:
  id: review-conditional-access-policies-count-sort-llm
  name: Review conditional access policies count sort llm
  description: Reviews conditional access policies and reports findings for admin review.
  version: 0.1.0
  minAppVersion: 0.1.0
  author:
    name: Community
    handle: community
  category: policies
  mode: read
skills:
  - id: load_conditional_access_policies
    format: graph
    label: Load conditional access policies
    detail: Reads conditional access policies from the active tenant.
    settings:
      method: GET
      path: /identity/conditionalAccess/policies
      select:
        - id
        - displayName
        - state
        - createdDateTime
        - modifiedDateTime
      scopes:
        - Policy.Read.All
  - id: count_by_state
    format: transform
    label: Count conditional access policies by state
    detail: Breaks conditional access policies down by state.
    settings:
      kind: count-by-field
      source: '{{ load_conditional_access_policies.output }}'
      field: state
      buckets:
        - enabled
        - disabled
        - enabledForReportingButNotEnforced
  - id: oldest_items
    format: transform
    label: Sample conditional access policies by modifiedDateTime
    detail: Lists conditional access policies ordered by modifiedDateTime.
    settings:
      kind: sort-by
      source: '{{ load_conditional_access_policies.output }}'
      field: modifiedDateTime
      direction: asc
      take: 10
  - id: summarize
    format: llm
    label: Summarize findings with the active LLM
    detail: Generates a short conditional access policies report.
    settings:
      system: >-

definition:
  triggers:
    - id: manual
      kind: manual
  result:
    summary: '{{ summarize.output.text | default("Summary unavailable.") }}'
    data:
      total: '{{ load_conditional_access_policies.output | size }}'
      breakdown: '{{ count_by_state.output }}'
      sample: '{{ oldest_items.output }}'
      llmSummary: '{{ summarize.output.text }}'
```

descriptor:

descriptor:

      breakdown: '{{ count_by_version.output }}'
      sample: '{{ oldest_items.output }}'

```yaml
descriptor:
  id: audit-settings-catalog-policies-llm-scheduled
  name: Audit settings catalog policies llm scheduled
  description: Reviews settings catalog policies and reports findings for admin review.
  version: 0.1.0
  minAppVersion: 0.1.0
  author:
    name: Community
    handle: community
  category: policies
  mode: read
skills:
  - id: load_settings_catalog_policies
    format: graph
    label: Load settings catalog policies
    detail: Reads settings catalog policies from the active tenant.
    settings:
      method: GET
      path: /deviceManagement/configurationPolicies
      select:
        - id
        - name
        - platforms
        - lastModifiedDateTime
      scopes:
        - DeviceManagementConfiguration.Read.All
  - id: summarize
    format: llm
    label: Summarize findings with the active LLM
    detail: Generates a short settings catalog policies report.
    settings:
      system: >-
        You review settings catalog policies for Microsoft 365 admins. Be concise, factual, and
        conservative. Use only the supplied data.
      prompt: >-
        Total settings catalog policies: {{ load_settings_catalog_policies.output | size }}.

        what to verify, next actions.
      temperature: 0.2
      maxTokens: 400
definition:
  triggers:
    - id: manual
      kind: manual
    - id: schedule
      kind: scheduled
      intervalSeconds: 86400
  result:
    summary: '{{ summarize.output.text | default("Summary unavailable.") }}'
    data:
      total: '{{ load_settings_catalog_policies.output | size }}'
      llmSummary: '{{ summarize.output.text }}'
```

```yaml
descriptor:
  id: review-users-count-llm-scheduled
  name: Review users count llm scheduled
  description: Reviews users and reports findings for admin review.
  version: 0.1.0
  minAppVersion: 0.1.0
  author:
    name: Community
    handle: community
  category: policies
  mode: read
skills:
  - id: load_users
    format: graph
    label: Load users
    detail: Reads users from the active tenant.
    settings:
      method: GET
      path: /users
      select:
        - id
        - displayName
        - userPrincipalName
        - accountEnabled
        - userType
        - createdDateTime
      scopes:
        - User.Read.All
  - id: count_by_usertype
    format: transform
    label: Count users by userType
    detail: Breaks users down by userType.
    settings:
      kind: count-by-field
      source: '{{ load_users.output }}'
      field: userType
      buckets:
        - Member
        - Guest
  - id: summarize
    format: llm
    label: Summarize findings with the active LLM
    detail: Generates a short users report.
    settings:
      system: >-
        You review users for Microsoft 365 admins. Be concise, factual, and conservative. Use only
        the supplied data.
      prompt: >-
        Total users: {{ load_users.output | size }}. Details: {{ count_by_usertype.output }}. Write
        a compact report: main finding, what to verify, next actions.
      temperature: 0.2
      maxTokens: 400
definition:
  triggers:
    - id: manual
      kind: manual
    - id: schedule
      kind: scheduled
      intervalSeconds: 604800
  result:
    summary: '{{ summarize.output.text | default("Summary unavailable.") }}'
    data:
      total: '{{ load_users.output | size }}'
      breakdown: '{{ count_by_usertype.output }}'
      llmSummary: '{{ summarize.output.text }}'
```

```yaml
descriptor:
  id: audit-organization-details-llm-scheduled
  name: Audit organization details llm scheduled
  description: Reviews organization details and reports findings for admin review.
  version: 0.1.0
  minAppVersion: 0.1.0
  author:
    name: Community
    handle: community
  category: compliance
  mode: read
skills:
  - id: load_organization_details
    format: graph
    label: Load organization details
    detail: Reads organization details from the active tenant.
    settings:
      method: GET
      path: /organization
      select:
        - id
        - displayName
        - verifiedDomains
        - createdDateTime
      scopes:
        - Organization.Read.All
  - id: summarize
    format: llm
    label: Summarize findings with the active LLM
    detail: Generates a short organization details report.
    settings:
      system: >-
        You review organization details for Microsoft 365 admins. Be concise, factual, and
        conservative. Use only the supplied data.
      prompt: >-
        Total organization details: {{ load_organization_details.output | size }}. Details: {{
        load_organization_details.output }}. Write a compact report: main finding, what to verify,
        next actions.
      temperature: 0.2
      maxTokens: 400
definition:
  triggers:
    - id: manual
      kind: manual
    - id: schedule
      kind: scheduled
      intervalSeconds: 86400
  result:
    summary: '{{ summarize.output.text | default("Summary unavailable.") }}'
    data:
      total: '{{ load_organization_details.output | size }}'
      llmSummary: '{{ summarize.output.text }}'
```

descriptor:

skills:

      field: userType
      buckets:
        - Member

    label: Sample users by createdDateTime
    detail: Lists users ordered by createdDateTime.
    settings:
      kind: sort-by
      source: '{{ load_users.output }}'
      field: createdDateTime
      direction: asc
      take: 10

    label: Summarize findings with the active LLM
    detail: Generates a short users report.
    settings:
      system: >-
        You review users for Microsoft 365 admins. Be concise, factual, and conservative. Use only
        the supplied data.

        Total users: {{ load_users.output | size }}. Details: {{ count_by_usertype.output }}. Write
        a compact report: main finding, what to verify, next actions.
      temperature: 0.2
      maxTokens: 400
definition:
  triggers:
    - id: manual
      kind: manual
  result:
    summary: '{{ summarize.output.text | default("Summary unavailable.") }}'
    data:
      total: '{{ load_users.output | size }}'
      breakdown: '{{ count_by_usertype.output }}'
      sample: '{{ oldest_items.output }}'
      llmSummary: '{{ summarize.output.text }}'
```

    label: Sample users by createdDateTime
    detail: Lists users ordered by createdDateTime.

Transform settings: kind (count-by-field | sort-by | group-by-field | group-by-age | filter-by-age), source "{{ <skillId>.output }}", and kind-specific fields. LLM settings: system, prompt, temperature, maxTokens. definition holds triggers ({id, kind: manual|scheduled, intervalSeconds}) and result (summary + data map). Reply with exactly one fenced yaml code block containing only the manifest.

Create an OpenAdminOS agent (slug review-directory-audit-events-sort-llm-scheduled, version 0.1.0, author Community/community) that reviews the tenant's directory audit events via /auditLogs/directoryAudits and an LLM-written summary. Include both a manual and a scheduled trigger.

```yaml
descriptor:
  id: review-directory-audit-events-sort-llm-scheduled
  name: Review directory audit events sort llm scheduled
  description: Reviews directory audit events and reports findings for admin review.
  version: 0.1.0
  minAppVersion: 0.1.0
  author:
    name: Community
    handle: community
  category: compliance
  mode: read
skills:
  - id: load_directory_audit_events
    format: graph
    label: Load directory audit events
    detail: Reads directory audit events from the active tenant.
    settings:
      method: GET
      path: /auditLogs/directoryAudits
      select:
        - id
        - activityDisplayName
        - initiatedBy
        - activityDateTime
        - result
      scopes:
        - AuditLog.Read.All
  - id: oldest_items
    format: transform
    label: Sample directory audit events by activityDateTime
    detail: Lists directory audit events ordered by activityDateTime.
    settings:
      kind: sort-by
      source: '{{ load_directory_audit_events.output }}'
      field: activityDateTime
      direction: asc
      take: 10
  - id: summarize
    format: llm
    label: Summarize findings with the active LLM
    detail: Generates a short directory audit events report.
    settings:
      system: >-
        You review directory audit events for Microsoft 365 admins. Be concise, factual, and
        conservative. Use only the supplied data.
      prompt: >-
        Total directory audit events: {{ load_directory_audit_events.output | size }}. Details: {{
        load_directory_audit_events.output }}. Write a compact report: main finding, what to verify,
        next actions.
      temperature: 0.2
      maxTokens: 400
definition:
  triggers:
    - id: manual
      kind: manual
    - id: schedule
      kind: scheduled
      intervalSeconds: 604800
  result:
    summary: '{{ summarize.output.text | default("Summary unavailable.") }}'
    data:
      total: '{{ load_directory_audit_events.output | size }}'
      sample: '{{ oldest_items.output }}'
      llmSummary: '{{ summarize.output.text }}'
```

descriptor:
  id: audit-groups-count-llm-scheduled
  name: Audit groups count llm scheduled
  description: Reviews groups and reports findings for admin review.
  version: 0.1.0
  minAppVersion: 0.1.0
  author:
    name: Community
    handle: community
  category: policies
  mode: read
skills:

        - id

        - groupTypes
        - membershipRule
        - createdDateTime
      scopes:

    format: transform
    label: Count groups by groupTypes
    detail: Breaks groups down by groupTypes.
    settings:
      kind: count-by-field
      source: '{{ load_groups.output }}'
      field: groupTypes
      buckets:

    label: Summarize findings with the active LLM
    detail: Generates a short groups report.
    settings:
      system: >-

      prompt: >-

      temperature: 0.2
      maxTokens: 400
definition:
  triggers:

    data:
      total: '{{ load_groups.output | size }}'
      breakdown: '{{ count_by_grouptypes.output }}'
      llmSummary: '{{ summarize.output.text }}'
```

Create an OpenAdminOS agent (slug review-conditional-access-policies-count-sort-llm-scheduled, version 0.1.0, author Community/community) that reviews the tenant's conditional access policies via /identity/conditionalAccess/policies with a per-field breakdown and an LLM-written summary. Include both a manual and a scheduled trigger.

```yaml
descriptor:
  id: review-conditional-access-policies-count-sort-llm-scheduled
  name: Review conditional access policies count sort llm scheduled
  description: Reviews conditional access policies and reports findings for admin review.
  version: 0.1.0
  minAppVersion: 0.1.0
  author:
    name: Community
    handle: community
  category: policies
  mode: read
skills:
  - id: load_conditional_access_policies
    format: graph
    label: Load conditional access policies
    detail: Reads conditional access policies from the active tenant.
    settings:
      method: GET
      path: /identity/conditionalAccess/policies
      select:
        - id
        - displayName
        - state
        - createdDateTime
        - modifiedDateTime
      scopes:
        - Policy.Read.All
  - id: count_by_state
    format: transform
    label: Count conditional access policies by state
    detail: Breaks conditional access policies down by state.
    settings:
      kind: count-by-field
      source: '{{ load_conditional_access_policies.output }}'
      field: state
      buckets:
        - enabled
        - disabled
        - enabledForReportingButNotEnforced
  - id: oldest_items
    format: transform
    label: Sample conditional access policies by modifiedDateTime
    detail: Lists conditional access policies ordered by modifiedDateTime.
    settings:
      kind: sort-by
      source: '{{ load_conditional_access_policies.output }}'
      field: modifiedDateTime
      direction: asc
      take: 10
  - id: summarize
    format: llm
    label: Summarize findings with the active LLM
    detail: Generates a short conditional access policies report.
    settings:
      system: >-
        You review conditional access policies for Microsoft 365 admins. Be concise, factual, and
        conservative. Use only the supplied data.
      prompt: >-
        Total conditional access policies: {{ load_conditional_access_policies.output | size }}.
        Details: {{ count_by_state.output }}. Write a compact report: main finding, what to verify,
        next actions.
      temperature: 0.2
      maxTokens: 400
definition:
  triggers:
    - id: manual
      kind: manual
    - id: schedule
      kind: scheduled
      intervalSeconds: 86400
  result:
    summary: '{{ summarize.output.text | default("Summary unavailable.") }}'
    data:
      total: '{{ load_conditional_access_policies.output | size }}'
      breakdown: '{{ count_by_state.output }}'
      sample: '{{ oldest_items.output }}'
      llmSummary: '{{ summarize.output.text }}'
```

An agent manifest is YAML with three required top-level keys: descriptor, skills, and definition. descriptor requires: id (kebab-case slug), name, description, version (semver), minAppVersion, author {name, handle}, category, mode (read or write). Each skill has: id (snake_case, no hyphens), format (graph | transform | llm), label, detail, settings. Graph settings: method, path, select, scopes. Transform settings: kind (count-by-field | sort-by | group-by-field | group-by-age | filter-by-age), source "{{ <skillId>.output }}", and kind-specific fields. LLM settings: system, prompt, temperature, maxTokens. definition holds triggers ({id, kind: manual|scheduled, intervalSeconds}) and result (summary + data map). Reply with exactly one fenced yaml code block containing only the manifest.

I need a compliance agent for OpenAdminOS: read provisioning audit events (fields: id, activityDateTime, provisioningAction, sourceSystem; permission AuditLog.Read.All). Slug: audit-provisioning-audit-events-list-scheduled. Schedule it to recur.

```yaml
descriptor:
  id: audit-provisioning-audit-events-list-scheduled
  name: Audit provisioning audit events list scheduled
  description: Reviews provisioning audit events and reports findings for admin review.
  version: 0.1.0
  minAppVersion: 0.1.0
  author:
    name: Community
    handle: community
  category: compliance
  mode: read
skills:
  - id: load_provisioning_audit_events
    format: graph
    label: Load provisioning audit events
    detail: Reads provisioning audit events from the active tenant.
    settings:
      method: GET
      path: /auditLogs/provisioning
      select:
        - id
        - activityDateTime
        - provisioningAction
        - sourceSystem
      scopes:
        - AuditLog.Read.All
definition:
  triggers:
    - id: manual
      kind: manual
    - id: schedule
      kind: scheduled
      intervalSeconds: 604800
  result:
    summary: Reviewed {{ load_provisioning_audit_events.output | size }} provisioning audit events.
    data:
      total: '{{ load_provisioning_audit_events.output | size }}'
```
